message: Gemfile does not match depcurfew.json: `source "https://rubygems.org"` should be `source "https://rubygems.org", cooldown: 3`
fix: Run depcurfew apply to bring Gemfile back in line with depcurfew.json (depcurfew apply --dry-run shows the change first), or change depcurfew.json if the edit was intended
